 Unifree Duty Free introduces dedicated K-Beauty area at IST
 By Faye Bartle | Sunday, 15 November 2026 12:16 
 Image Credit: Unifree Duty Free To celebrate the launch, Unifree Duty Free transformed the area into an interactive experience zone throughout October, hosting special K-Pop dance performances. 
 Unifree Duty Free has launched a dedicated K-Beauty area at Istanbul Airport (IST), showcasing a selection of Korea’s most sought-after skincare brands, including Laneige, Anua and COSRX.  
 To celebrate the launch, Unifree Duty Free turned the area into an interactive experience zone throughout October, hosting special K-Pop dance performances.
 “At Unifree Duty Free, we continuously evolve our retail offering in line with emerging consumer trends and the expectations of our diverse international passenger base,” said Ceren Tonguç, Chief Commercial Officer at Unifree Duty Free.
 “The launch of our dedicated K-Beauty area reflects the growing global appeal of Korean beauty brands and our commitment to bringing the most relevant and sought-after concepts to Istanbul Airport.
 “By combining a curated brand selection featuring Laneige, Anua and COSRX with engaging cultural elements such as K-Pop performances, we have created a destination that goes beyond traditional retail.
 “This initiative is part of our broader strategy to deliver innovative, experience-driven shopping environments that enhance the passenger journey and strengthen Istanbul Airport’s position as a leading global travel retail hub.”
 Image Credit: Unifree Duty Free The dedicated area has a fresh and contemporary aesthetic featuring soft pink tones. It allows passengers to discover innovative beauty products and routines that have gained a strong global following in recent years. 
 With its strong appeal among Generation Z and Millennial consumers, K-Beauty is an influential trends shaping the beauty industry.
 The move forms part of Unifree Duty Free’s plans to ensure travellers have access to the latest innovations and trends shaping the beauty category.
 Image Credit: Unifree Duty Free The new space showcases some of Korea’s most sought-after skincare brands, including Laneige, Anua and COSRX.
